messages:
Theo: Spontaneous idea  parkour laps around the courtyard + sandwich-forfeit? 12:40 kickoff. Quick, silly, low-impact options available. :dash: :sandwich:
Mina: Parkour?? As in, hop little walls and cut the corner? Im intrigued but cautious. :grimacing:
Jules: Ill do the low-impact lap (no vaults). Also bringing mini first-aid (blister pads).
Rafa: Im dumb enough to try the fancy line. If I eat it, I buy lunch for everyone. Deal? :sweat_smile:
Theo: Deal. Rule: keep it safe. No flips. Two laps max, staggered starts. Sandwich-forfeit if you take an extended break or bail. :ok_hand:
Wellness-bot: Event created: "Courtyard laps & silly sandwich-forfeit" @12:40 (30m). Reminder 10m before.
Mina: Question: any kids/visitors in the courtyard? We should avoid showing off if there are families.
Jules: Good call. I checked earlier, usually clear at 12:30 but I'll double-check before we start.
Rafa: Ill bring a cheap paper sandwich token as the forfeit. Loser puts it on their desk all afternoon. :bread:
Theo: Warmup suggestion: 5 mins dynamic mobility, ankle circles, hip openers. Ill lead a 3-min demo of safe vaults for those interested.
Mina: Ill do demo + one cautious lap. If its wet Im out.
Jules: Bringing a small towel and antiseptic wipes. Safety first.
Rafa: Also bringing my tiny speaker for ridiculous victory music. Preferences? 80s pop or chip-tune? :notes:
Theo: 80s pop for maximum dramatic sandwich shame. :smile:
Wellness-bot: Weather update: light breeze, surface dry. No rain expected in the next hour.
Mina: Final tally: cautious line 2 (Mina, Jules), fancy line 1 (Rafa), demo/organizer 1 (Theo).
Jules: Meetup: courtyard north gate at 12:35 to warm up. Pics and very brief recap in #random after. No long vids pls.
Theo: Also tiny etiquette note: if you see someone struggling, stop and check ankle. Were here for fun, not ego.
Rafa: On my way. Hope my knees forgive me. If not, sandwich it is. :crossed_fingers:
Mina: See you there!
